entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand. Order number is VF-85621-PULSE.

Okay, one moment while I pull that up... I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered 18 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a return. I don't want it. I already tried to do this online last week but your website crashed.
I'm sorry to hear that. You're saying there was a website error when you tried to start the return process? Can you recall the approximate date?
Around the 24th of December. The whole system was down. I got an error page and couldn't print the label. I even took a screenshot if you need to see it.

No, that won't be necessary, thank you for the detail. I'm checking our system logs now... and yes, I can confirm we had a known outage that day that impacted our returns portal. I sincerely apologize for the trouble that caused.
So can you process the return or not?
Absolutely. Let me just confirm the return policy here... Okay, it shows your delivery was on December 15th. You're well within the 90-day return window, so this is no problem at all.
Good. So you're sending the label?

Yes, I've just processed the return authorization. The prepaid shipping label should be in your email inbox now. And for the inconvenience caused by our system being down, and as a thank you for being a VIP customer, I've also added a $50 VeloFit credit to your account.
Okay, the email just came through. I see the credit. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
